decisions.statement: A seat is working until an answer ends its turn.
A prompt with nothing answering that prompt yet is a turn still to finish.
A prompt saying the user interrupted the request ends the turn.
A request interrupted while a tool ran is interrupted as any other is.
An answer saying the user interrupted the request ends no turn.
A record's words are read whether its content is text or a run of blocks.
A record that is neither a prompt nor an answer neither starts nor ends a turn.
A compaction ending ends the turn the compaction interrupted.
The summary a compaction wrote starts no turn.
The harness's own echo of a local command starts no turn.
A prompt or an answer after a compaction starts the turn again.
Unread is not off.
An unread seat and a seat that is not working are told apart.
A transcript is read forward from the byte the transcript was last read to.
A transcript no longer than when that transcript was last read is not read again.
A transcript shorter than when that transcript was last read is read from its first byte.
A read ends at the last line end rather than part way through a line.
A stretch of transcript holding no answer leaves the turn reading unchanged.
The byte a transcript was read to is kept beside the seat.
A background command starts a task the transcript names.
A background command is the only task read here.
No subagent is read out of a transcript here.
A subagent is read from the page put up for that subagent instead.
A task is live from the record starting the task until the notification naming the task.
A task the seat stopped is live no longer.
A task started again after its notification is live again.
Which tasks are live is kept beside the seat.
A reading kept before tasks were read is read again from the first byte.
A reading kept in an unknown shape is unread.
A task in a replaced transcript is live to nothing here.
A task runs inside the client the transcript belongs to.
A client spawned in place of an earlier client runs no task already open.
The client running a task writes the notice closing the task.
A client replaced while a task was open writes nothing closing the task.
The byte the transcript was read to survives the open tasks being taken away.
No hook is asked for a seat's turn state or live tasks.
No process is read to find a task.

definition: what one read of a seat's transcript says about the turn and the commands still running
